title: Add observed-cost reconciler and stepped-span sampler for multi-phase invocations
author: Priya Menon
description:
Motivation:
Long-running and multi-phase invocations (streaming + post-process) regularly show divergence between the cost we attribute at the token level and what infra-level kernel/GPU utilization traces show. This makes it hard to detect true regressions and causes noisy billing alerts for customers.

This PR introduces two pieces: (1) an observed-cost reconciler that combines token-cost estimates with kernel-level timing and per-GPU utilization traces to compute a reconciled per-invocation cost and (2) a stepped-span sampler that takes targeted span samples at configured invocation phases (prefetch, decode, postprocess) to retain high-fidelity traces for long-tail / streaming invocations without exploding trace volume.

What this changes (high-level):
- New metric series: invocation.observed_cost_usd, invocation.kernel_time_ms, invocation.gpu_active_pct, invocation.cost_discrepancy_pct.
- New trace enrichment: reconciled_cost tag on root spans, phase=prewarm|decode|postprocess span tags and sampled stack traces for those phases.
- Stepped-span-sampler: sampling policy implemented in telemetry agent to sample up to N spans per invocation phase with reservoir per-tenant.
- Dashboard: Observability -> Cost Reconciliation panel that surfaces heatmaps of discrepancy by route/model and a waveform view of kernel time vs token-cost.
- Alert tuning: new alert rule SLO-OBS-COST-DRIFT that triggers when median cost_discrepancy_pct > 15% for 10m and > 25% for 5m under high-confidence sampling. Alerts auto-mute for low-volume tenants.

- [x] Implement stepped-span-sampler in telemetry-agent with per-tenant reservoir
- [x] Add dashboards and panels (grafana JSON)
- [x] Add unit + integration tests for reconciler logic and sampling heuristics
- [x] Backfill smoke job for synthetic invocation replay to validate reconciler outputs
- [x] Documentation: observability/cost/reconciliation.md and example alert runbook

Commits (summary):
- feat(telemetry): introduce observed-cost reconciler and reconciliation config
- feat(telemetry-agent): stepped-span-sampler with phase-reservoir and tenant controls
- feat(dashboards): add reconciled cost heatmap and waveform panel
- test(telemetry): add reconciler unit tests and synthetic replay harness
- docs(obs): add reconciliation docs and alert runbook

Changed files (representative):
- telemetry/processor/reconciler.go (new) -- core reconciliation algorithm: merge(token_cost_estimate, kernel_timings, gpu_util) -> observed_cost_usd
- telemetry/agent/sampler/stepped_sampler.go (new) -- per-tenant phase-based reservoir sampler with eviction policy
- telemetry/metrics/metrics_defs.yaml (update) -- new metric defs and labels
- dashboards/cost/reconciliation.json (new) -- grafana panels and templates
- infra/synthetic-replay/job.yaml (update) -- nightly replay to generate reconciliation testcases
- docs/observability/cost/reconciliation.md (new) -- user-facing docs and runbook
- telemetry/processor/reconciler_test.go (new)

Small code snippet (reconciler core):
```
// pseudocode: reconcile token estimate with kernel timings
func Reconcile(e TokenEstimate, k KernelTimings, u Utilization) ObservedCost {
    base := e.estimated_usd
    kernelAdj := k.decode_ms/total_ms * kernelCostFactor
    utilAdj := (u.gpu_active_pct - baselinePct) * utilCostFactor
    return ObservedCost{Usd: base + kernelAdj + utilAdj}
}
```

Testing and validation:
- Unit tests cover corner cases: streaming with long prewarm, zero-kernel timings, missing GPU telemetry.
- Integration test: synthetic-replay job runs 1k invocations nightly and compares reconciled_cost to token estimates. We add assertions to check that the discrepancy distribution is stable (median < 8% for canary models).
- Load: stepped-span-sampler uses reservoir size defaults tuned to keep trace volume <= +10% of current baseline in staging.

Migration notes / rollout plan:
1) Feature gated behind org-level config (observability.reconciler.enabled) default off.
2) Start with canary tenants (internal and 3 pilot customers).
3) Enable sampling at low rate (phase reservoir 2) and run synthetic-replay for 24h.
4) If discrepancy stable, increase sampling reservoir and unflag deployment.

Backwards compatibility / cost:
- Metrics are additive; no breaking changes to existing metric names.
- The reconciler emits an optional reconciled_cost tag so older dashboards continue to work.
- Increased telemetry storage from sampled spans is expected; stepped sampler mitigates the growth.

Documentation and runbook: docs/observability/cost/reconciliation.md includes: how to interpret observed_cost_usd, how to map reconciliation results to billing, and remediation runbook for SREs and Solutions Engineers.

Discussion and decisions log (summary):
- We chose phase-based reservoir sampling vs adaptive rate sampling because it preserves one sample per logical stage (prefetch/decode/postprocess) which improves root-cause for multi-stage latencies.
- Reconciler uses a lightweight parametric model (scale factors) instead of full kernel-cost regression to avoid heavy weight in realtime processing; we plan a follow-up PR for offline ML-based calibration.

Related work / follow-ups:
- ENG-1523: offline calibration job to learn kernelCostFactor by model family
- ENG-1620: expose reconciled_cost in tenant-facing billing UI (follow-up after validation)

Notes for reviewers: please focus on the reservoir eviction logic (stepped_sampler.go) and the reconciliation weighting constants in reconciler.go. We intentionally kept the model simple; if you think we must include a per-model-family multiplier now, call it out and we'll scope to a follow-up.

discussion:
Ethan Caldwell: Left a question about eviction fairness in multi-tenant situations; suggested using weighted reservoir by tenant request rate.
Priya Menon (author): Responded that we intentionally bias toward lower-rate tenants to ensure we get samples for long-tail users, added a knob tenant.sample_bias to config.
Marisol Vega: Requested a guardrail to ensure we don't exceed trace quota; author added a circuit-breaker tied to tenant.quota_usage_pct.
Jun Park: Approved after seeing staging synthetic replay graphs; requested a follow-up ENG ticket to expose per-model multipliers for reconciliation.
release_notes: Adds observed-cost reconciliation metrics and a stepped-span sampler to improve attribution for multi-phase and streaming invocations; includes dashboards and alert rule for cost drift. Feature gated and rolled out to canary tenants first.
